projects.title: GlassSlipper.js — Real-Time Ephemeral Full-Stack Platform
projects.short_description: Production-engineered full-stack platform translating Cinderella fairytale constraints into concrete microservices.
projects.description: Architected a high-density real-time distributed platform balancing strict ephemeral session lifetimes, high-density traffic spikes, and dynamic algorithmic match brokerage. Implements the Midnight Invalidation Service, Glass Slipper Fit Logic, and the Pumpkin Cluster scaling simulation.
highlights: Midnight Invalidation Engine: Redis-backed distributed cron flushes active JWTs at absolute deadlines, triggering atomic PostgreSQL state rollbacks
Glass Slipper Fit Logic: Regex verification pipeline enforcing strict schemas (e.g. 10-digit mobile matching) and issuing ephemeral certificates
Dynamic Pricing Broker (POST /api/v1/marketplace/bargain): Evaluates incoming bids against mid-market indexes within a 4% tolerance or computes algorithmic counter-proposals
The Pumpkin Cluster: Infrastructure scaling simulation gracefully degrading from high-resource cluster to single-node container upon deadline breach
Real-time bidirectional synchronization across active clients using FastAPI WebSockets & Socket.io

projects.title: Apex: Distributed Sliding-Window Rate Limiter
projects.short_description: Distributed token-bucket & sliding-window rate limiting engine with sub-millisecond Redis clustering.
projects.description: Engineered a standalone distributed rate limiter for API gateways. Implements atomic Lua scripts inside Redis clusters to guard microservices against volumetric spikes and DDoS attacks.
highlights: Sustains 45,000+ requests/sec with p99 latency under 1.8ms in load testing
Atomic Lua scripts guarantee zero race conditions across multi-node clusters
Prometheus metrics exporter with custom Grafana dashboards for live traffic observability

projects.title: ChronoSync: Distributed Real-Time WebSocket Broker
projects.short_description: Horizontal WebSocket pub/sub fabric synchronizing live state across thousands of concurrent clients.
projects.description: Built an event-driven pub/sub broker using Python AsyncIO, Redis Streams, and WebSockets. Dispatches low-latency push notifications and live transactional state updates with guaranteed delivery order.
highlights: Sub-10ms broadcast latency across 20,000 active concurrent WebSocket connections
Heartbeat health monitoring and auto-reconnecting client reconnect logic
Integrated transactional PostgreSQL audit log for persistent message verification

projects.title: Sentinel: Real-time Orderbook & Event Pipeline
projects.short_description: Asynchronous WebSocket pipeline streaming financial orderbook depth data into timeseries databases.
projects.description: Event-driven system consuming level-2 market depth feeds across major crypto exchanges. Normalizes high-throughput trade feeds and calculates real-time volatility indices.
highlights: Ingests 50,000+ ticks/sec with zero memory leaks
Fault-tolerant auto-reconnect WebSocket connection pool
Automatic anomaly alerts sent via Webhook and Telegram bot

projects.title: PyForge: Zero-Dependency Static Generator
projects.short_description: Lightweight, blazing-fast static site builder powered exclusively by the Python Standard Library.
projects.description: Created a developer-first static site generator with zero external pip dependencies. Includes a custom template parser, live preview server, and GitHub Pages deployment workflow.
highlights: Zero pip dependencies required — runs out-of-the-box on standard Python 3
Compiles complex responsive sites in under 10 milliseconds
Built-in file watching and live-reload HTTP server

projects.title: CloudSync CLI: Multi-Cloud Backup Automation
projects.short_description: Intelligent command-line tool for differential encrypted backups across AWS S3 and local storage.
projects.description: A cross-platform CLI tool built with Python's Argparse and Cryptography. Detects modified binary chunks to perform fast incremental uploads with client-side AES-GCM encryption.
highlights: Chunk-level deduplication reduces upload bandwidth by 65%
Multiprocessing worker pool maximizes network throughput
Automated cron-ready scheduling and error alerting
